actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares Core US Aggregate Bond ETF (AGG)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war may lead to a decrease in investor sentiment, causing a decline in bond prices and an increase in stock prices. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) is a good buy as it tracks the S&P 500 index, which is expected to rise due to the increase in defense spending.
